protocols.title: Noopept (20 mg) Dosage Protocol — source reference
protocols.purpose: Individual-page schedule and handling details, transcribed as a research/educational reference
protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. Page reports one open clinical study amount: 20 mg/day orally, conventionally split 10 mg twice daily for two months, in 60 stroke patients. No reconstitution/injection. Evidence limited to small open Russian-language reports; FDA treats it as an unapproved new drug, not a dietary ingredient.

schedule.description: 20 mg/day split as 10 mg twice daily.

regimen.notes: The source reports 20 mg/day orally, split 10 mg twice daily, for two months in a small open stroke-patient study. This is a study schedule, not an established recommendation.
